narrative.intro: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies has $2.2B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Honeywell recorded 1 award so far, with an average award size of $2.2B, and obligations are up 4.2% year over year. Historic obligations show a multi-year record: $1.7B in FY21, $2B in FY22, $1.8B in FY23, $1.8B in FY24, $2.1B in FY25, and $2.2B in FY26. The current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the headline figures are contract obligations except where award-value is noted. These figures indicate the vendor is working from a concentrated award base in FY2026, given that total obligations and average award size are the same dollar amount. Procurement teams and partners should note the firm-level scale and the year-over-year increase when assessing market positioning or planning outreach, while remembering that the FY2026 totals are not full-year results.
